```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Read the data
data <- read_csv(here("output_data/Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected/constraint_impact_analysis/constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv"))

# Data preparation
plot_data <- data %>%
  # Clean up marine zone names for better display
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    # Clean up SSP names
    SSP_clean = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5", 
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
      TRUE ~ SSP
    ),
    # Create a year variable for x-axis (use decade midpoint for plotting)
    Year = case_when(
      Decade == "2021_2030" ~ 2025,
      Decade == "2031_2040" ~ 2035,
      Decade == "2041_2050" ~ 2045,
      Decade == "2051_2060" ~ 2055,
      Decade == "2061_2070" ~ 2065,
      Decade == "2071_2080" ~ 2075,
      Decade == "2081_2090" ~ 2085,
      Decade == "2091_2100" ~ 2095,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Calculate free area (High_Confidence - constraints)
    Free_Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2 - Constraint_Area_km2
  ) %>%
  # Filter to only include the high confidence areas 
  select(SSP_clean, Year, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Free_Area_km2, Constraint_Area_km2, High_Confidence_km2)

# Current aquaculture usage
current_usage <- 25.88

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year)) +
  # Add ribbon showing constraint area (gray background) - only where constraints exist
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = Constraint_Area_km2), 
              fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.7, 
              data = plot_data %>% 
                filter(Pattern == "suitable", Constraint_Area_km2 > 0)) +  # Only show where constraints > 0
  
  # Add lines for free area - dashed for suitable, solid for optimal
  geom_line(aes(y = Free_Area_km2, color = SSP_clean, linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  
  # Add horizontal line for current aquaculture usage at 25.88 km²
  geom_hline(yintercept = current_usage, 
             color = "red", 
             linetype = "dotted", 
             size = 0.8,
             alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Add text annotation for current usage line
  annotate("text", x = 2030, y = current_usage * 1.5, 
           label = paste0("Current usage: ", current_usage, " km²"), 
           color = "red", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  
  # Facet by marine zone
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Customize line types
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("optimal" = "solid", "suitable" = "dashed"),
                       name = "pattern",
                       labels = c("optimal" = "Optimal", "suitable" = "Suitable")) +
  
  # Customize colors for SSP scenarios using viridis (colorblind-friendly)
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "SSP Scenario", option = "D") +
  
  # Axis labels and title
  labs(
    x = "Decade",
    y = expression("Area (km²)"),
    title = "Climate Analogues: Free Area Available After Constraints",
    subtitle = paste0("Gray area = Constraints; Red dotted line = Current usage (", current_usage, " km²)"),
    caption = "Solid lines = Optimal analogues, Dashed lines = Suitable analogues"
  ) +
  
  # Theme customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")
  ) +
  
  # Adjust x-axis to show decade labels properly
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2025, 2095, 10),
                    labels = c("2021-2030", "2031-2040", "2041-2050", "2051-2060", 
                              "2061-2070", "2071-2080", "2081-2090", "2091-2100")) +
  
  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Display the plot
print(p)

# Save the plot
ggsave(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024", "climate_analogues_constraints_plot.png"), 
       plot = p, 
       width = 12, 
       height = 10, 
       dpi = 300)

# Optional: Print constraint data to check the High Seas issue
print("Constraint data check:")
constraint_check <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Year == 2025, Pattern == "suitable") %>%
  select(Marine_Zone, Constraint_Area_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Free_Area_km2) %>%
  mutate(Constraint_Percentage = round((Constraint_Area_km2 / (High_Confidence_km2 + Constraint_Area_km2)) * 100, 1))

print(constraint_check)
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Read the data
data <- read_csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv"))

# Data preparation
plot_data <- data %>%
  # Clean up marine zone names for better display
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    # Clean up SSP names
    SSP_clean = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5", 
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
      TRUE ~ SSP
    ),
    # Create a year variable for x-axis (use decade midpoint for plotting)
    Year = case_when(
      Decade == "2021_2030" ~ 2025,
      Decade == "2031_2040" ~ 2035,
      Decade == "2041_2050" ~ 2045,
      Decade == "2051_2060" ~ 2055,
      Decade == "2061_2070" ~ 2065,
      Decade == "2071_2080" ~ 2075,
      Decade == "2081_2090" ~ 2085,
      Decade == "2091_2100" ~ 2095,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Calculate free area (High_Confidence - constraints)
    Free_Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2 - Constraint_Area_km2,
    # Calculate the top of constraint area for ribbon
    Constraint_Top = Constraint_Area_km2
  ) %>%
  # Filter to only include the high confidence areas 
  select(SSP_clean, Year, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Free_Area_km2, Constraint_Area_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Constraint_Top)

# Current aquaculture usage
current_usage <- 25.88

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year)) +
  # Add horizontal line showing constraint level (constant across time)
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = Constraint_Area_km2), 
             color = "gray60", 
             linetype = "solid", 
             size = 1.2,
             alpha = 0.8,
             data = plot_data %>% 
               filter(Pattern == "suitable") %>%
               group_by(Marine_Zone) %>%
               slice(1)) +  # Only show once per marine zone
  
  # Add lines for free area - dashed for suitable, solid for optimal
  geom_line(aes(y = Free_Area_km2, color = SSP_clean, linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  
  # Add horizontal line for current aquaculture usage at 25.88 km²
  geom_hline(yintercept = current_usage, 
             color = "red", 
             linetype = "dotted", 
             size = 0.8,
             alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Facet by marine zone
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Customize line types
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("optimal" = "solid", "suitable" = "dashed"),
                       name = "pattern",
                       labels = c("optimal" = "Optimal", "suitable" = "Suitable")) +
  
  # Customize colors for SSP scenarios using viridis (colorblind-friendly)
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "SSP Scenario", option = "D") +
  
  # Axis labels and title
  labs(
    x = "Decade",
    y = expression("Area (km²)"),
    title = "Climate Analogues: Free Area Available After Constraints",
    subtitle = paste0("Gray line = Constraint level; Red dotted line = Current usage (", current_usage, " km²)"),
    caption = "Solid lines = Optimal analogues, Dashed lines = Suitable analogues"
  ) +
  
  # Theme customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")
  ) +
  
  # Adjust x-axis to show decade labels properly
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2025, 2095, 10),
                    labels = c("2021-2030", "2031-2040", "2041-2050", "2051-2060", 
                              "2061-2070", "2071-2080", "2081-2090", "2091-2100")) +
  
  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Display the plot
print(p)

# Save the plot
ggsave(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024", "climate_analogues_constraints_plot.png"), 
       plot = p, 
       width = 12, 
       height = 10, 
       dpi = 300)

# Optional: Print constraint data to check the High Seas issue
print("Constraint data check:")
constraint_check <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Year == 2025, Pattern == "suitable") %>%
  select(Marine_Zone, Constraint_Area_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Free_Area_km2) %>%
  mutate(Constraint_Percentage = round((Constraint_Area_km2 / (High_Confidence_km2 + Constraint_Area_km2)) * 100, 1))

print(constraint_check)
```

#using data2- file area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints at folder  output_data/Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Read both datasets
data <- read_csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv"))
data2 <- read_csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"))

# Let's examine the structure of data2 first
print("Data2 structure:")
print(head(data2))
print("Unique columns in data2:")
print(colnames(data2))

# Data preparation for data2
plot_data2 <- data2 %>%
  # Clean up marine zone names for better display
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    # Clean up SSP names
    SSP_clean = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5", 
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
      TRUE ~ SSP
    ),
    # Create a year variable for x-axis (use decade midpoint for plotting)
    Year = case_when(
      Decade == "2021_2030" ~ 2025,
      Decade == "2031_2040" ~ 2035,
      Decade == "2041_2050" ~ 2045,
      Decade == "2051_2060" ~ 2055,
      Decade == "2061_2070" ~ 2065,
      Decade == "2071_2080" ~ 2075,
      Decade == "2081_2090" ~ 2085,
      Decade == "2091_2100" ~ 2095,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Calculate total area and constraint percentage
    Total_Area_km2 = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    # Available area is High_Confidence (this should be the free area after constraints)
    Free_Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2,
    # Constrained area
    Constraint_Area_km2 = Unsuitable_Constraints_km2
  ) %>%
  select(SSP_clean, Year, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Free_Area_km2, Constraint_Area_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Total_Area_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2)

# Current aquaculture usage
current_usage <- 25.88

# Create comparison plots side by side using data2
p2 <- ggplot(plot_data2, aes(x = Year)) +
  # Show constraint area as ribbon from 0 to constraint level
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = Constraint_Area_km2), 
              fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.7, 
              data = plot_data2 %>% 
                filter(Pattern == "suitable") %>%
                group_by(Marine_Zone, Year) %>%
                slice(1)) +  # Only show once per year per zone
  
  # Add lines for available area (High_Confidence) - dashed for suitable, solid for optimal
  geom_line(aes(y = Free_Area_km2, color = SSP_clean, linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  
  # Add horizontal line for current aquaculture usage at 25.88 km²
  geom_hline(yintercept = current_usage, 
             color = "magenta", 
             linetype = "dotted", 
             size = 0.8,
             alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Facet by marine zone
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Customize line types
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("optimal" = "solid", "suitable" = "dashed"),
                       name = "Pattern",
                       labels = c("optimal" = "Optimal", "suitable" = "Suitable")) +
  
  # Customize colors for SSP scenarios using viridis (colorblind-friendly)
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "SSP Scenario", option = "D") +
  
  # Axis labels and title
  labs(
    x = "Decade",
    y = expression("Area (km²)"),
    title = "Climate Analogues: Available Area with Constraints (Data2)",
    subtitle = paste0("Gray area = Constraints; Red dotted line = Current usage (", current_usage, " km²)"),
    caption = "Solid lines = Optimal analogues, Dashed lines = Suitable analogues"
  ) +
  
  # Theme customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")
  ) +
  
  # Adjust x-axis to show decade labels properly
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2025, 2095, 10),
                    labels = c("2021-2030", "2031-2040", "2041-2050", "2051-2060", 
                              "2061-2070", "2071-2080", "2081-2090", "2091-2100")) +
  
  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Display the new plot
print(p2)

# Compare constraint levels between datasets
print("Constraint comparison between datasets:")
constraint_comparison <- data2 %>%
  filter(Decade == "2021_2030", Pattern == "suitable") %>%
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    Total_Area = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    Constraint_Percent = round((Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 / Total_Area) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Marine_Zone, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Total_Area, Constraint_Percent)

print(constraint_comparison)
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Read both datasets
data <- read_csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv"))
data2 <- read_csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"))

# Let's examine the structure of data2 first
print("Data2 structure:")
print(head(data2))
print("Unique columns in data2:")
print(colnames(data2))

# Data preparation for data2
plot_data2 <- data2 %>%
  # Clean up marine zone names for better display
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    # Clean up SSP names
    SSP_clean = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5", 
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
      TRUE ~ SSP
    ),
    # Create a year variable for x-axis (use decade midpoint for plotting)
    Year = case_when(
      Decade == "2021_2030" ~ 2025,
      Decade == "2031_2040" ~ 2035,
      Decade == "2041_2050" ~ 2045,
      Decade == "2051_2060" ~ 2055,
      Decade == "2061_2070" ~ 2065,
      Decade == "2071_2080" ~ 2075,
      Decade == "2081_2090" ~ 2085,
      Decade == "2091_2100" ~ 2095,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Calculate total area and constraint percentage
    Total_Area_km2 = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    # Available area is High_Confidence (this should be the free area after constraints)
    Free_Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2,
    # Constrained area
    Constraint_Area_km2 = Unsuitable_Constraints_km2
  ) %>%
  select(SSP_clean, Year, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Free_Area_km2, Constraint_Area_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Total_Area_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2)

# Current aquaculture usage
current_usage <- 25.88

# Create comparison plots side by side using data2
p2 <- ggplot(plot_data2, aes(x = Year)) +
  # Show constraint area as ribbon from 0 to constraint level
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = Constraint_Area_km2), 
              fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.7, 
              data = plot_data2 %>% 
                filter(Pattern == "suitable") %>%
                group_by(Marine_Zone, Year) %>%
                slice(1)) +  # Only show once per year per zone
  
  # Add lines for available area (High_Confidence) - dashed for suitable, solid for optimal
  geom_line(aes(y = Free_Area_km2, color = SSP_clean, linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  
  # Add horizontal line for current aquaculture usage at 25.88 km²
  geom_hline(yintercept = current_usage, 
             color = "#E7298A", # Magenta from colorbrewer (colorblind-friendly)
             linetype = "dotted", 
             size = 0.8,
             alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Create a dummy data point for the current usage line to appear in legend
  geom_point(aes(y = current_usage, color = "Current Usage"), 
             x = -Inf, size = 0, alpha = 0) + # Invisible point just for legend
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Facet by marine zone
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Customize line types
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("optimal" = "solid", "suitable" = "dashed"),
                       name = "Pattern",
                       labels = c("optimal" = "Optimal", "suitable" = "Suitable")) +
  
  # Customize colors for SSP scenarios using viridis (colorblind-friendly) + current usage
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SSP1-1.9" = "#440154FF", 
                               "SSP1-2.6" = "#31688EFF",
                               "SSP2-4.5" = "#35B779FF", 
                               "SSP3-7.0" = "#FDE725FF",
                               "SSP5-8.5" = "#FFFFFF",  # Will be overridden by viridis
                               "Current Usage" = "#E7298A"),
                    name = "SSP Scenario") +
  # Override with viridis for SSP scenarios only
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "SSP Scenario", option = "D",
                       aesthetics = "color",
                       guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = c(rep("solid", 5), "dotted"),
                                                               size = c(rep(1, 5), 0.8)))) +
  
  # Axis labels and title
  labs(
    x = "Decade",
    y = expression("Area (km²)"),
    title = "Climate Analogues: Available Area with Constraints",
    subtitle = "Gray area = Constraints; Magenta dotted line = Current usage",
    caption = "Solid lines = Optimal analogues, Dashed lines = Suitable analogues"
  ) +
  
  # Theme customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")
  ) +
  
  # Adjust x-axis to show decade labels properly
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2025, 2095, 10),
                    labels = c("2021-2030", "2031-2040", "2041-2050", "2051-2060", 
                              "2061-2070", "2071-2080", "2081-2090", "2091-2100")) +
  
  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Display the new plot
print(p2)

# Compare constraint levels between datasets
print("Constraint comparison between datasets:")
constraint_comparison <- data2 %>%
  filter(Decade == "2021_2030", Pattern == "suitable") %>%
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    Total_Area = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    Constraint_Percent = round((Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 / Total_Area) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Marine_Zone, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Total_Area, Constraint_Percent)

# Save both plots in the Figures folder
ggsave(here("Figures", "climate_analogues_constraints_data2.png"), 
       plot = p2, 
       width = 12, 
       height = 10, 
       dpi = 300)

ggsave(here("Figures", "climate_analogues_constraints_data2.pdf"), 
       plot = p2, 
       width = 12, 
       height = 10, 
       dpi = 300)

print("Plots saved to Figures folder!")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Read both datasets
data <- read_csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv"))
data2 <- read_csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"))

# Let's examine the structure of data2 first
print("Data2 structure:")
print(head(data2))
print("Unique columns in data2:")
print(colnames(data2))

# Data preparation for data2
plot_data2 <- data2 %>%
  # Clean up marine zone names for better display
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    # Clean up SSP names
    SSP_clean = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5", 
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
      TRUE ~ SSP
    ),
    # Create a year variable for x-axis (use decade midpoint for plotting)
    Year = case_when(
      Decade == "2021_2030" ~ 2025,
      Decade == "2031_2040" ~ 2035,
      Decade == "2041_2050" ~ 2045,
      Decade == "2051_2060" ~ 2055,
      Decade == "2061_2070" ~ 2065,
      Decade == "2071_2080" ~ 2075,
      Decade == "2081_2090" ~ 2085,
      Decade == "2091_2100" ~ 2095,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Calculate total area and constraint percentage
    Total_Area_km2 = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    # Available area is High_Confidence (this should be the free area after constraints)
    Free_Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2,
    # Constrained area
    Constraint_Area_km2 = Unsuitable_Constraints_km2
  ) %>%
  select(SSP_clean, Year, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Free_Area_km2, Constraint_Area_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Total_Area_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2)

# Current aquaculture usage
current_usage <- 25.88

# Create comparison plots side by side using data2
p2 <- ggplot(plot_data2, aes(x = Year)) +
  # Show constraint area as ribbon from 0 to constraint level
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = Constraint_Area_km2), 
              fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.7, 
              data = plot_data2 %>% 
                filter(Pattern == "suitable") %>%
                group_by(Marine_Zone, Year) %>%
                slice(1)) +  # Only show once per year per zone
  
  # Add lines for available area (High_Confidence) - dashed for suitable, solid for optimal
  geom_line(aes(y = Free_Area_km2, color = SSP_clean, linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  
  # Add horizontal line for current aquaculture usage at 25.88 km²
  geom_hline(yintercept = current_usage, 
             color = "#E7298A", # Magenta from colorbrewer (colorblind-friendly)
             linetype = "dotted", 
             size = 0.8,
             alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Create a dummy data point for the current usage line to appear in legend
  geom_point(aes(y = current_usage, color = "Current Usage"), 
             x = -Inf, size = 0, alpha = 0) + # Invisible point just for legend
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Facet by marine zone
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Customize line types
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("optimal" = "solid", "suitable" = "dashed"),
                       name = "Pattern",
                       labels = c("optimal" = "Optimal", "suitable" = "Suitable")) +
  
  # Customize colors for SSP scenarios using viridis (colorblind-friendly) + current usage
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SSP1-1.9" = "#440154FF", 
                               "SSP1-2.6" = "#31688EFF",
                               "SSP2-4.5" = "#35B779FF", 
                               "SSP3-7.0" = "#FDE725FF",
                               "SSP5-8.5" = "#FFFFFF",  # Will be overridden by viridis
                               "Current Usage" = "#E7298A"),
                    name = "SSP Scenario") +
  # Override with viridis for SSP scenarios only
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "SSP Scenario", option = "D",
                       aesthetics = "color",
                       guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = c(rep("solid", 5), "dotted"),
                                                               size = c(rep(1, 5), 0.8)))) +
  
  # Axis labels and title
  labs(
    x = "Decade",
    y = expression("Area (km²)"),
    title = "Climate Analogues: Available Area with Constraints",
    subtitle = "Gray area = Constraints; Magenta dotted line = Current usage",
    caption = "Solid lines = Optimal analogues, Dashed lines = Suitable analogues"
  ) +
  
  # Theme customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")
  ) +
  
  # Adjust x-axis to show decade labels properly
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2025, 2095, 10),
                    labels = c("2021-2030", "2031-2040", "2041-2050", "2051-2060", 
                              "2061-2070", "2071-2080", "2081-2090", "2091-2100")) +
  
  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Display the new plot
print(p2)

# Compare constraint levels between datasets
print("Constraint comparison between datasets:")
constraint_comparison <- data2 %>%
  filter(Decade == "2021_2030", Pattern == "suitable") %>%
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    Total_Area = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    Constraint_Percent = round((Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 / Total_Area) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Marine_Zone, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Total_Area, Constraint_Percent)

# Save both plots in the Figures folder
ggsave(here("Figures", "climate_analogues_constraints_data2.png"), 
       plot = p2, 
       width = 12, 
       height = 10, 
       dpi = 300)

ggsave(here("Figures", "climate_analogues_constraints_data2.pdf"), 
       plot = p2, 
       width = 12, 
       height = 10, 
       dpi = 300)

print("Plots saved to Figures folder!")
```
